Name: Tortoiseshell Cat
Author: magemeows
Description:
[size=3]I wanted my Stardew Valley cat to look like my real cat, but nobody's made a tortoiseshell mod. So I made one myself! It's a simple recolor and slight modification of the original cat.

I've tested it in my own game and it seems to work fine, but let me know if you notice any issues.[/size]

[color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Instructions:[/size][/color][list]
[*][size=3]Create a backup for the cat.xnb file. This can be found by going to your game folder > content > animals. Make a copy and save it somewhere you can easily find it. This is so that the file can be replaced if there are any issues, or if you decide you want the default cat instead.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download my cat mod and open the .zip file. Copy the cat.xnb file and paste it into the animals folder. Let it override the default file.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[color=#3c78d8]Edit:
[/color]
I've added different eye colors. You can now choose between yellow, blue, green, blue-green, and black.
